onset.Description: Start of the trial segment in this file (trials are written back-to-back)

trial_type.Description: 'trial' = one released epoch (2 s before stimulus presentation to 2 s after the end of speech, per the article)

trial_index.Description: 1-based index of the trial in D.trial

sample.Description: First sample (0-based) of the trial segment in this file

source_time_start.Description: First value of D.time for this trial (seconds, the authors' recording clock); consecutive trials overlap on this clock

source_time_end.Description: Last value of D.time for this trial

badtrial_final.Description: 1 if the trial index is in D.badtrial_final (authors' final bad-trial list)

codingbad.Description: 1 if listed in D.codingbad_idx (speech coding criteria not met)

quanbad.Description: 1 if listed in D.quanbad_idx (quantitative artifact detection)

word.Description: Item read aloud in this trial (D.epoch.word, verbatim), from the source table D.epoch of the trial's MAT file (sourcedata/dryad-zpc866t75-deidentified), added 30 Oct 2026. Lexical status (word/nonword) is not in the release.

phonetic_code.Description: Phonetic transcription of the production (D.epoch.phoneticCode, verbatim; LaTeX TIPA notation as stored); n/a when the cell is empty (13 of 3057 trials).

err_cons1.Description: Articulation note for the first consonant (D.epoch.err_cons1, verbatim); n/a when empty.

err_vowel.Description: Articulation note for the vowel (D.epoch.err_vowel, verbatim); n/a when empty.

err_cons2.Description: Articulation note for the second consonant (D.epoch.err_cons2, verbatim); n/a when empty.

list_item.Description: Position of the item in the session's 120-item list (D.epoch.trial_id).

stimulus_onset.Description: Stimulus presentation onset, in seconds of this file: onset + (D.epoch.stimulus_starts - source_time_start).

speech_onset.Description: Speech onset, in seconds of this file: onset + (D.epoch.onset_word - source_time_start).

speech_offset.Description: Speech offset, in seconds of this file: onset + (D.epoch.offset_word - source_time_start); n/a when it falls outside the stored trial segment (1 partial trial).

vowel_onset.Description: Vowel onset, in seconds of this file: onset + (D.epoch.onset_vowel - source_time_start).

vowel_offset.Description: Vowel offset, in seconds of this file: onset + (D.epoch.offset_vowel - source_time_start).

timing_note.Description: n/a, or which D.epoch time fell outside this trial's stored segment and was therefore not placed (trials are stored back to back, so such a time would point into another trial's samples).
